Idaho: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Idaho on the map

Key dates

  • Voter pre-registration deadline: October 23, 2026. Your county clerk must receive your registration by 5 p.m. local time. You can also register at your polling place on Election Day.
  • Absentee ballot application deadline: October 23, 2026. Your county clerk must receive your application by 5 p.m. local time. Completed ballots must arrive by 8 p.m. on November 3.
  • Early voting (in-person absentee) ends: October 30, 2026. Each county sets its own early voting dates and hours, but all early voting ends at 5 p.m. on October 30. Check with your county clerk.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. local time.

Official election information: vote.gov

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

Governor

This seat has a four-year term. Republican incumbent Brad Little is running for a third term. In Idaho the lieutenant governor is elected separately, not on a joint ticket.
